title: CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert is Surprised
chineseTitle: 第 3 章：玛丽拉·卡斯伯特大吃一惊

paragraphs.en: Marilla Cuthbert was taken aback when Matthew opened the door, seeing an odd little figure in a stiff dress and long red braids. "Matthew Cuthbert, who's this?" she asked, surprised.
paragraphs.zh: 马修·库伯特一开门，便见一个穿着硬挺衣服、留着长红辫子的奇怪小身影，玛丽拉·库伯特不禁,"); "马修·库伯特，这是谁？”她惊讶地问道。

paragraphs.en: "Where is the boy?"
paragraphs.zh: “那孩子呢？”

paragraphs.en: "There wasn't any boy," Matthew replied miserably. "There was only her."
paragraphs.zh: “没有男孩，”马修沮丧地回答道，“只有她一个人。”

paragraphs.en: He gestured towards the child, whom he had not even asked for a name.
paragraphs.zh: 他朝那个孩子挥了挥手，连问她名字都没有。

paragraphs.en: "No boy! But there must have been a boy," Marilla insisted. "We sent Mrs. Spencer to bring a boy."
paragraphs.zh: “没有男孩！但肯定是有男孩的，”玛丽拉坚持道，“我们派斯宾塞太太去接一个男孩。”

paragraphs.en: "Well, she didn’t. She brought her. I asked the station-master. And I had to bring her home.
paragraphs.zh: “她没有带？她带来了。我问过车站站长了。而且我还得把她送回家。”

paragraphs.en: She couldn't be left there, no matter where the mistake came from."
paragraphs.zh: 无论如何，她不能被留在那里。

paragraphs.en: "This is a mess!" Marilla exclaimed.
paragraphs.zh: “这简直是一团糟！”玛丽拉脱口而出。

paragraphs.en: The child remained silent during their exchange, her eyes shifting between them until she seemed to understand. Dropping her carpet-bag, she stepped forward and clasped her hands together.
paragraphs.zh: 孩子在他们的对话中保持沉默，目光在两人之间游移，直到似乎明白了什么。她放下手提包，向前迈步，双手紧紧相握。

paragraphs.en: "You don’t want me!" she cried. "You don't want me because I'm not a boy!
paragraphs.zh: “你们不要我！”她喊道，“你们不要我是因为我不是男孩！

paragraphs.en: I might have expected it. Nobody ever did want me. I might have known it was all too beautiful to last.
paragraphs.zh: 我早该想到这是怎么回事。没人真正想要我，这美丽的一切终究还是昙花一现。

paragraphs.en: I might have known nobody really did want me. Oh, what shall I do? I’m going to burst into tears!"
paragraphs.zh: 我早该知道没有人真想收留我。哦，我该怎么办？我都要哭出来了！

paragraphs.en: She began to cry, sitting down on a chair by the table and burying her face in her arms. Marilla and Matthew looked at each other awkwardly across the stove, unsure of how to react. Finally, Marilla stepped forward.
paragraphs.zh: 她坐在桌子旁的一把椅子上，埋头伏在双臂中哭泣。玛丽拉和马修站在炉子两侧尴尬地对视着，不知该如何应对。最终，玛丽拉迈前一步。

paragraphs.en: "Well, well, there's no need to cry so much about it."
paragraphs.zh: “嗐，别哭得这么夸张了。”

paragraphs.en: "Yes, there is!" The child raised her head quickly, revealing a tear-stained face and trembling lips. "You would cry too if you were an orphan and had come to what you thought was home only to find they didn't want you because you weren’t a boy.
paragraphs.zh: “是的，有！”孩子迅速抬起头来，泪痕未干的脸庞和微微颤抖的嘴唇显露无遗。“如果你是个孤儿，本以为来到这里就是家了，结果却发现自己不受待见，不是男孩的话，你也会哭的。”

paragraphs.en: Oh, this is the most tragic thing that ever happened to me!"
paragraphs.zh: 哦，这真是我经历过的最悲惨的事情！

paragraphs.en: Marilla's expression softened slightly as she said, "Well, don't cry anymore. We're not going to turn you out tonight. You'll have to stay here until we investigate this matter.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉的表情稍微柔和了一些，说道：“好了，别哭了。今晚我们不会把你赶走。你得留下来，等我们调查清楚这件事。”

paragraphs.en: What’s your name?"
paragraphs.zh: “你叫什么名字？”

paragraphs.en: The child hesitated for a moment before saying eagerly, "Will you please call me Cordelia?"
paragraphs.zh: 孩子犹豫了一下，然后急切地说：“你们能不能叫我科黛莉亚？”

paragraphs.en: Anne Shirley insisted on being called Cordelia, explaining that she preferred the name despite it not being her own. Marilla Cuthbert, unimpressed, dismissed Anne's preference as "unromantic fiddlesticks." Anne countered that spelling her name with an 'e' made it look more distinguished.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮·谢里登坚持要别人叫她科黛丽亚，解释说尽管这个名字不是她的，但她还是更喜欢这个名字。玛丽拉·库伯对此不以为然， dismissively 称安妮的偏好是“没 romance 的胡闹”。安妮反驳说，在名字后面加个‘e’会让它看起来更有风度。

paragraphs.en: Marilla then inquired about how the mistake of sending for a girl instead of a boy occurred. Mrs. Spencer had clearly stated they wanted a young female, and the matron thought Anne would fit the description. Anne was overjoyed at the prospect, unable to sleep from excitement.
paragraphs.zh: 接着，玛丽拉询问起为何会错将一个女孩当作男孩送来。斯宾塞太太明确表示她们想要一个年轻的女性，而女校长认为安妮符合这个描述。对于这一出乎意料的好消息，安妮激动得整晚都难以入眠。

paragraphs.en: She reproached Matthew for not warning her at the station.
paragraphs.zh: 她责怪马修没有在车站提醒她。

paragraphs.en: Marilla wondered aloud what Matthew meant by their conversation on the road. Matthew quickly excused himself to tend to the mare, leaving Marilla to continue questioning Anne about the situation.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉不禁出声疑惑，马修在路上的那番话究竟是什么意思。马修迅速找借口去照料母马，留下玛丽拉继续追问安妮事情的原委。

paragraphs.en: Marilla brought Lily Jones for Anne. At five years old, Lily was beautiful with nut-brown hair. Anne wondered if Marilla would keep her if she were as pretty.
paragraphs.zh: 玛莉拉带来了莉莉·琼斯，安妮今年五岁。莉莉长着一头栗色的头发，非常漂亮。安妮心想，如果自己也这么漂亮的话，玛莉拉会不会收留她呢？

paragraphs.en: "No," replied Marilla. "We need a boy to help Matthew on the farm. A girl wouldn't be useful."
paragraphs.zh: “不，”玛丽拉回答，“我们需要一个男孩来帮助马修在农场干活。女孩在这方面帮不上忙。”

paragraphs.en: Anne took off her hat meekly and sat down for supper but couldn’t eat. She nibbled at bread and butter, picking at crab-apple preserve, yet made no progress.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮温顺地摘下帽子，坐下来吃晚饭，却一点也吃不下。她只咬了几口面包黄油，夹了点苹果酱，但根本没有什么胃口。

paragraphs.en: "Are you not eating?" asked Marilla sharply. Anne sighed, explaining she was in despair and couldn’t swallow anything, even a chocolate caramel.
paragraphs.zh: “你不吃东西吗？”玛丽拉尖锐地问道。安妮叹了口气，解释说她心情沮丧，连巧克力焦糖都咽不下去。

paragraphs.en: Matthew returned from the barn and suggested putting Anne to bed. Marilla had prepared a couch for a boy but decided against it for a girl. The spare room wasn't suitable, so they went to the east gable room.
paragraphs.zh: 马修从谷仓回来，建议把安妮送回床上。玛丽拉本打算为男孩准备一个睡榻，但考虑到是女孩便放弃了这个念头。备用房间不太合适，于是她们来到了东面的那间山墙房。

paragraphs.en: Marilla lit a candle and asked if Anne had a nightgown. Anne nodded.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉点燃了一根蜡烛，问安妮是否有夜裙。安妮点了点头。

paragraphs.en: Marilla left Anne to undress quickly and go to bed. She warned her not to light the candle herself, fearing an accident.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉让安妮赶快脱衣上床，自己先出去了。她叮嘱安妮不要自己点蜡烛，担心会发生意外。

paragraphs.en: Anne looked around her sparsely furnished room with longing. The whitewashed walls were starkly bare, and the only floor covering was a unique braided mat. The high, old-fashioned bed had dark posts, while in another corner stood a rigid table adorned with a firm red velvet pin-cushion.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮环视着她简陋的房间，眼中满是渴望。洁白的墙壁上空无一物，只有一张独特的编织垫子作为地面覆盖物。高高的老式床架有着深色的柱子，在另一个角落里则摆放着一张僵硬的桌子，上面放着一个结实的红绒线针垫。

paragraphs.en: Above it hung a small mirror. Between the table and bed was a window draped with white muslin, opposite which was a wash-stand.
paragraphs.zh: 在它上方悬挂着一面小镜。桌子和床之间有一扇窗户，窗户上挂着雪白的orgette纱布窗帘，对面则摆放着一个梳妆台。

paragraphs.en: Marilla tidied Anne's clothes neatly on a prim yellow chair before going to the bed. She said goodnight awkwardly but kindly.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉把安妮的衣服整理得整整齐齐地放在一张拘谨的黄色椅子上，然后走向床边。她虽然有些局促，但还是礼貌地说了晚安。

paragraphs.en: Anne’s face appeared over the covers, her eyes wide with reproach. "How can you call it a good night when you know it must be the worst?" she said.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮的脸从被子下探出来，眼睛睁得大大的，带着责备的神情。“你怎么能说这是个好夜呢？明明知道这肯定是最糟糕的一个。”她说。

paragraphs.en: Then she burrowed under the blankets again.
paragraphs.zh: 然后她又缩回被子里。

paragraphs.en: Marilla went down to the kitchen and began washing the supper dishes. Matthew was smoking, a sign of his worry. He rarely smoked, but Marilla allowed it occasionally.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉走进厨房开始洗晚餐的碗碟。马修正在抽烟，这表明他心情不佳。他很少抽烟，但玛丽拉偶尔会允许他抽。

paragraphs.en: "Such a mess," she said angrily. "This is what happens when we send messages instead of going ourselves. The Spencers must have misunderstood our message.
paragraphs.zh: “一团糟，”她生气地说，“这都是因为我们发了消息而没有亲自去。斯宾塞一家肯定误解了我们的意思。”

paragraphs.en: We'll need to drive over and see Mrs. Spencer tomorrow. This girl has to be sent back to the asylum."
paragraphs.zh: 我们明天得去斯宾塞太太那里一趟。这个女孩必须被送回疗养院。

paragraphs.en: "Yes, I suppose so," Matthew replied reluctantly.
paragraphs.zh: 马修勉强应道：“是的，我想应该是这样的。”

paragraphs.en: "You SUPPOSE so! Do you know it?"
paragraphs.zh: “你以为当然就是这样吗！你知道吗？”

paragraphs.en: "Well, she's a nice little thing, Marilla. It’s a pity to send her away when she wants to stay here."
paragraphs.zh: “她倒是挺乖巧的一个小姑娘，玛丽拉。把她送走未免有些可惜，因为她还想留在这里呢。”

paragraphs.en: "Matthew Cuthbert, do you think we should keep her?"
paragraphs.zh: “马修，你觉得我们应该收留她吗？”

paragraphs.en: Marilla was shocked. "No, I don't believe that child has bewitched you! You want to keep her, don’t you?"
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉惊讶不已：“不，我不相信那个孩子会把你迷住了！你真的想收留她吧？”

paragraphs.en: "Well, she is interesting," Matthew stammered. "You should have heard her talk at the station."
paragraphs.zh: “她确实挺有趣的，”马修结结巴巴地说，“你要是听见她在车站说的话就好了。”

paragraphs.en: "Oh, she talks too much. That’s not good. And I don’t want an orphan girl anyway.
paragraphs.zh: “她说话太多，这不太好。再说，我本来也不打算收养一个孤儿女孩的。”

paragraphs.en: There's something about her I don't understand. She has to go back."
paragraphs.zh: 她身上有些地方我不太明白，她必须得回去。

paragraphs.en: "I could hire a French boy for help," said Matthew. "She'd be company for you."
paragraphs.zh: “我可以雇个法国男孩来帮忙，”马修说道，“他还能陪你作伴。”

paragraphs.en: "I'm not in need of company," Marilla replied curtly. "And I won’t keep her."
paragraphs.zh: “我不需要陪伴，”玛丽拉干脆地说，“而且我不会留她在这里。”

paragraphs.en: "Of course, as you say, Marilla," Matthew said, putting his pipe away and going to bed.
paragraphs.zh: “当然，正如你说的，玛丽拉。”马修说着，把烟斗收起来，上床睡觉了。

paragraphs.en: Marilla put the dishes away and went to bed, frowning. Upstairs, a lonely child cried herself to sleep in the east gable.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉收拾好餐具后上床睡觉，皱着眉头。楼上，孤独的安妮在东面的山墙里哭累了，自己睡着了。
